title: Chapter 1363 - 30: Temporal Lifeform "Galaxy" (End Of This Volume)
content:
Chapter 1363 - 30: Temporal Lifeform "Galaxy" (End Of This Volume)

Chapter 1363: Chapter 30: Temporal Lifeform "Galaxy" (End of This Volume)

The last major realm crossing occurred when the eleventh layer broke through to the twelfth layer.

At that time, Lin Yuan is still in his home universe.

The Chaos Void Origin Infusion endured tore a rift that connected the Primordial Lands, spanning even a million light-years.

Even so, compared to other breakers of the same level, it was already tens of thousands of times larger.

For a normal life crossing into the twelfth layer, even when enduring the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, the rift formed spanned only a few light-years to ten light-years.

This is already tens of thousands of times in diameter.

When it comes to bearing the amount and weight of the origin source,

The difference is simply immeasurable.

And now.

Lin Yuan goes from the twelfth layer to the thirteenth layer.

He no longer endures the Chaos Void Origin in the form of a rift.

At this moment, Lin Yuan seems to be merging with the Chaos Void Origin.

The vast and endless origin pours entirely towards him.

The entire Chaos Void, because of the overwhelming burden, begins to actively operate frantically, devouring madly towards the external dimensional gaps.

The Chaos Void is a top-dimensional space, and its interior has already formed a cycle, under normal circumstances, it basically does not need to absorb energy from outside dimensions.

However, now, this cycle has been broken by Lin Yuan, as the origin source is greatly infused, it is forced to actively absorb and exhale external energy.

"So comfortable."

With the endless infusion of origin, Lin Yuan only feels the universe within him rapidly filling up.

Due to the advancement of the realm, the transcendence of the essence of life, the universe within Lin Yuan also begins to expand rapidly.

And expansion means that sufficient energy support is needed.

With the size of Lin Yuan’s internal universe, only the Chaos Void itself can somewhat satisfy the demand for large-scale expansion at the moment.

If categorized by level, the size of the Chaos Void is probably equivalent to a time lord of the third realm.

Of course, this ’time lord’ does not have specific consciousness, just a matter of comparable size.

The thirteenth layer legacy, "Infinite Void" founded by Lord Mo Xu, as long as it is cultivated to the theoretical limit, elevating the internal universe to the Infinite Void level comparable to the Chaos Void, then it will approach the Time Lord class.

A true Time Lord relies not only on his own size.

Even if the size is comparable, it is only close.

Besides the frantic expansion of the universe within, the endless Constant Sand Particle Worlds within Lin Yuan are also expanding frantically.

A single Constant Sand Particle World can definitely not compare to the internal universe, the foundational difference is too great.

But the endless Constant Sand Particle Worlds, when combined, absorb and devour the Chaos Void Origin even more than the internal universe.

...

The Chaos Void is operating at overload, devouring the endless energy of the external dimensional gaps with all its might.

In the eyes of life forms below the thirteenth layer, the dimensional gap appears empty, but to Time Life and even dimensional space,

The dimensional gap is filled with a certain dark energy, which only dimensional spaces can devour, and Time Life can absorb to a certain extent.

Rumble——

For a moment, centered around the Chaos Void, a large area of dark energy is absorbed and devoured, affecting even other distant dimensional spaces.

"What’s going on?"

"What happened in that dimensional space?"

"What are Lord Mo Xu and the others doing?"

One by one, Time Life forms felt something, gazing distantly at the Chaos Void.

Such an extravagant devouring of dark energy is rarely seen, generally only occurring after the great destruction of a dimensional space followed by its rebirth.

But now, the Chaos Void is still far from such a great destruction.

...

"This commotion..."

Lord Mo Xu and the other eight Time Life forms exchanged glances with each other.

They could clearly sense the ’strain’ of the Chaos Void, all showing a hint of being unable to supply Lin Yuan.

One should know, the size of the Chaos Void is comparable to a Time Lord, under such circumstances, it cannot supply Lin Yuan, how robust must the latter’s reserves be?

"Too terrifying."

Luo Hou breathed a light sigh, he had just broken through to the thirteenth layer not long ago.

And had a deep understanding of the Chaos Void Origin Infusion endured during the twelfth and thirteenth layers.

The Chaos Void Origin Infusion he endured at the time caused only a tenth, or a fifth of the Chaos Void’s origin to pour.

Even so, Luo Hou was almost overwhelmed and exploded by the endless Chaos Void Origin.

But for Lin Yuan?

Not only is the entire Chaos Void fully infusing, it has also started endlessly absorbing and exhaling towards the external dimensional gaps.

Such a difference is far beyond that of hundreds or thousands of times simple.

"Could it be that Galaxy, just having become the thirteenth layer, is about to approach the Second Realm?"

A thought suddenly emerged in Luo Hou’s mind, startling even himself.

Thirteenth layer Time Life is divided into First Realm, Second Realm, Third Realm.

The Third Realm is the status of a Time Lord, occupying a vast region of dimensional gaps,

Under normal circumstances, Time Lords have their own pursuits and rarely interfere with unrelated matters.

So Second Realm Time Life, basically has already become dominant in one area, these thirteenth layers have already long left their home dimensional space.

Approaching the Second Realm? Many Time Life having completed a cycle of great destruction, have not reached this domain.

Lin Yuan just crossed into the thirteenth layer, and was deemed by Luo Hou to be approaching the Second Realm, it is already a very incredible speculation.

Under such circumstances, a little further cultivation would fully cross into the Second Realm.

Among the newly ascended Time Life forms, the gap between each other is not that large, which of them crossed into the thirteenth layer without peerless talent?

...

Meanwhile.

The sentient beings within the Chaos Void also noticed the anomaly of Lin Yuan’s devouring of the Chaos Void Origin.
